rv.q: Just a few feet away from any of us, Rapp shares his character’s yearning, resentments and sense of life’s disappointments in a paradoxically life-affirming and relatable way that we can almost touch.
Our sympathy for Sydney, and our complicity with him, elevate Touch beyond a morality play about victimhood.

cn.t: Anthony Rapp delivers a satisfying, intimate solo performance in this simple yet powerful 90-minute story. Critics praise the show's emotional depth and stripped-down staging in the 40-seat East Village Basement venue.
